provenance.note: Written from the artifact repository (system/README.md, system/app/page.tsx, system/lib/prompts.ts, system/lib/interfaces.ts, system/components/ClickLogger.ts, system/public/sandbox/index.html, system/lib/Tetris/data.json) and from one recorded session (evidence 01-08). A learner is taken through a game (Tetris by default) step by step: they write the main steps and then the requirements for each step into a chat with an LLM Teaching Assistant, play the groundtruth Solution game in a Python/Skulpt sandbox, and have a game generated from their own requirements onto the My canvas sandbox to see what those requirements produce. No description of the software from outside the pack was consulted.
